title: How pieces move
info: Each piece has its own move. Only the knight jumps over other pieces.
Rooks go straight. Bishops go diagonally. The queen does both. The king moves one square.

questions.q: Which piece can jump over others?

options: straight, any number of empty squares
across the board like a rook every turn
by jumping two ranks as its normal move
